items.title: Parents go against court orders after children 'traumatised'
items.description: The Family Court granted John full custody of his kids but he returned them to their mother, saying the judge got it wrong.

items.title: Drivers wait months for faults to be repaired on EVs built by new brands
items.description: As an influx of car brands enters the market, dealers ask for a change to consumer laws to fix a grey area that makes them responsible for warranty repairs.

items.title: Live: Donald Trump gives prime-time address on election security
items.description: US President Donald Trump delivers a prime-time national address about newly declassified intelligence on investigations into elections.  He says the documents have been gathered by the White House Government Transparency Taskforce and the Intelligence Advisory Board. Follow live

items.title: 'They were not random attacks': The tankers targeted in the Strait of Hormuz
items.description: The commercial tankers struck as they transited the Strait of Hormuz in recent weeks were not random, but part of a "highly, highly targeted" campaign run by Tehran, according to marine traffic watchers.

items.title: A gulf has opened up between the Liberals and the zeitgeist
items.description: The mismatch between where the public resides and what the Liberals are expounding is a deeper challenge — a gulf perhaps unable to be bridged, at least in the short term.

items.title: Live: 'Great mates': Joyce shuts down talk of rift with Hanson after far-right podcast
items.description: Barnaby Joyce has defended his relationship with One Nation leader Pauline Hanson after she sat down for a podcast conversation with UK far-right activist Tommy Robinson. Follow live.

items.title: Sam Neill died from a common infection. Here's how it turned deadly
items.description: After the actor's death from pneumonia, here's what to know about the common infection, its symptoms and why it can sometimes become deadly.

items.title: Vaping in decline as young Australians shift to other nicotine products
items.description: Vaping and smoking rates are on the decline, but a shift to other nicotine products could represent an increase in average use.

items.title: UK urges FIFA to act after Argentine players hold up Falklands banner
items.description: The British government urges FIFA to investigate after Argentine players held up a banner declaring the Falkland Islands were Argentinian.

items.title: When is the World Cup final? All you need to know about Spain vs Argentina
items.description: The World Cup final is nearly upon us, with Spain to face Argentina for the ultimate prize. Here's everything you need to know about the biggest game in football.

items.title: Former diplomat complains of Triple Zero outages on Telstra's 'priority' service
items.description: Telstra promised Alastair Gaisford that his wife's healthcare was a priority. But he says 15 landline outages, including some that could have prevented the ability to call Triple Zero in an emergency, have convinced him otherwise.

items.title: Uber reverses 'disability tax' after outcry
items.description: Uber has reversed its decision to impose a $5 fee on passengers requiring extra assistance, after advocates and service providers labelled it discriminatory and a "disability tax".

items.title: Teleprompter operator suspended over bets on Trump's speeches
items.description: US President Donald Trump's longtime technician allegedly made over $142,000 by placing bets on what Donald Trump would say in speeches.

items.title: 'People want something different': Ardern on the rise of fringe politics
items.description: The former New Zealand prime minister reflects on leading through crisis, becoming a mother while running a country and why she believes voters are craving something different.

items.title: Will Ferrell channels Ricky Bobby in TV return
items.description: Plus a noir mystery set in outback Coober Pedy, a true crime drama which doesn't exploit its victims, and more new TV to watch this month.

items.title: Friday news quiz: The iconic film Sam Neill rejected, a royal reunion and a mystery outbreak
items.description: Our weekly quiz has the film Sam Neill "didn't think was funny", plus the sweetness at the centre of our galaxy.

items.title: Owning a home in Sydney has become a pipe dream for many, how about other states?
items.description: Sydney is no longer affordable for most, as new data reveals the number of people who own the home they live in is the lowest it has been in decades.

items.title: Ex Wagga MP Daryl Maguire found guilty of conspiracy over fraudulent visas
items.description: After five days of deliberation in the NSW District Court the former Member for Wagga Wagga was found to have conspired to provide false or misleading information to the Commonwealth on visas for Chinese nationals seeking permanent residency.

items.title: Queensland hospital settles dispute with psychiatrist over gender care
items.description: Dr Jillian Spencer has ended her employment with Queensland Children's Hospital after reaching a confidential settlement with Children’s Health Queensland, bringing an end to a three-year dispute.

items.title: The unanswered question in the rush for Queensland's hidden oil jackpot
items.description: An expert is warning that the push to fast-track approvals for the proposed Taroom Trough lacks crucial detail.

items.title: 'Substantial clean-up effort' needed for shuttered manganese smelter
items.description: Australia's only manganese alloy smelter has closed, leaving the future of the site uncertain and the country more reliant on imported alloys for steel production.

items.title: NT child protection bill opponents show 'moral bankruptcy', MLA says
items.description: Fierce debate has surrounded the Northern Territory government's child protection reforms — which will return to parliament for debate next week — with one MLA saying those opposing it have shown "a degree of moral bankruptcy".

items.title: 'Best place to look for life': Atmosphere discovered on Earth-like planet
items.description: The search for life beyond Earth has marked a new discovery — evidence of an atmosphere on an Earth-like planet beyond our Solar System with modelling suggesting it may be a water world.

items.title: Protesters criticise Zelenskyy after Ukrainian defence minister's sacking
items.description: A dispute between the now former defence minister Mykhailo Fedorov and Kyiv's top general is spilling into public, after Volodymyr Zelenskyy orders a second reshuffle of this year.

items.title: Father 'disgusted' over inadequacy of charges after Laos methanol poisoning
items.description: A Melbourne father whose daughter died from methanol poisoning in Laos has said he is "disgusted" over the inadequacy of charges expected to be laid.
